references_named: Robert Barry, During the exhibition the gallery will be closed (1969)
rationale: The mechanism IS the concept with no decoration: the browser's navigator.onLine signal — a piece of platform plumbing normally used to scold you — is elevated to institutional door state. Concept and execution collapse perfectly (P1, P3). Double-coding lands cleanly: surface gag is the literal inversion of Barry's 1969 instruction, deeper reading is the net.art paradox of an anti-institutional medium that needs you to leave the network. The 'open' state is a deliberately empty room, which is the right amount of restraint. Voice is textbook cheerful-cynic: 'You left the internet to arrive.' Attribution, license, and zero-network delivery all conform.
reservations: The inversion of Barry, while exact, is the obvious move — a jury that values surprise may dock novelty. The author also candidly notes the piece sits on presence/absence rather than the chance/order axis (P5); that's defensible given the source, but worth flagging for the twenty-year argument.
